<passage n="02" section="6. Work Assignments; 7. Special Instructions">
6. Work Assignments

a. Patrol and restore the FDR-AIK-2207 trunk first (PS-17 supply), then FDR-AIK-2219.

b. 2207: start at SUB-AIK-BRAMBLEGATE breaker, patrol trunk to the PS-17 tap. Clear, repair,
   report ready-to-close to DCC. Laterals after trunk energized.

c. 2219: trunk only this OP unless released by Div Sup.

d. Report damage counts (poles, xfmrs, spans) to Div Sup at 1000, 1400, 1700.

e. Road closures to Logistics on F-MAL-030.

7. Special Instructions

No bucket work above 30 mph sustained wind. Div Sup calls stand-down/resume from DCC wind
reading. Treat all lines energized until grounded per TSO 06.130. Switching by DCC order only.
Do not drive through water over a roadway (GEP 2F.01 sec 6.1). Tallow Branch hospital on own
generator; water supply rides on PS-17. 2207 is the priority. Job briefing at each new location;
F-DOM-118 tailboard sheet.
</passage>
